== Purpose ==
Holds the open-case counts that come from lists rather than categories, so [[Help Complete the Archive]] and [[Mysteries]] show one number from one place. Counts that come from a category are live and stay on the hub as <code><nowiki>{{PAGESINCATEGORY:…}}</nowiki></code>.

== Values ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Key !! Value !! Counted from
|-
| <code>photos</code> || {{Archive open cases|photos}} || Rows with a File on [[Unidentified event photographs]]
|-
| <code>decks</code> || {{Archive open cases|decks}} || Decklist links on [[Unknown players]]
|-
| <code>players</code> || {{Archive open cases|players}} || Pages in [[:Category:Players]] still waiting for a photograph (of {{Archive open cases|players-all}})
|-
| <code>worlds</code> || {{Archive open cases|worlds}} || [[:Category:World Championships]] pages still waiting for a photograph: [[2003 World Championship|2003]], [[2004 World Championship|2004]], [[2005 World Championship|2005]], [[2006 World Championship|2006]]
|-
| <code>updated</code> || {{Archive open cases|updated}} || Date of the last recount
|}

When you remove rows from one of those lists, or add a photograph to a player page, update the number here and the <code>updated</code> date.
